title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E10 — A Crash or a Kill Mystery
Wealthy retired executive Ken Abbott and his wife, Celeste, are said to have died in a fiery car crash in New Jersey, but when the family can't get answers to simple questions about their deaths, police discover a gruesome crime motivated by greed.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E5 — My Name Is Clark Rockefeller
A serial imposter pretends to be an aristocrat and Rockefeller fortune heir; when bones are dug up behind a house in an affluent California community, police want to know who Clark Rockefeller really is.

title: American Greed
description:
S12 E14 — Online Dating Trap
Daylon Pierce is a consummate ladies' man who claims to be a licensed stockbroker, wooing unsuspecting women through internet dating sites; after the women hand over millions of dollars, Pierce robs them blind and breaks their hearts.

title: American Greed
description:
S8 E7 — The Falcon and the Con Man
A man attempts suicide and confesses to an extraordinary fraud that he perpetrated for the past two decades at a leading commodity futures brokerage.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E4 — Kevin Cohen: Baby Broker Scam
Attorney Kevin Cohen uses his adoption annex to take advantage of couples seeking to adopt children.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E18 — The Busted Mogul
Lobsang Dargey, a Tibetan Buddhist Monk, escapes Chinese oppression and claws his way to freedom in the U.S.; uneducated and broke, but rich with ambition, Dargey catapults from odd jobs to real estate development.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E14 — Mark Weinberger: Nose No Bounds
An esteemed doctor turns to white-collar crime and becomes a most-wanted fugitive.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E1 — Suicide Is Painless
Hedge-fund manager Samuel Israel III fakes his own death after defrauding investors of more than $450 million.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E8 — Capturing The Fugitives
Law enforcement apprehends criminals featured on the show with the help of vigilant viewers.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E13 — Deadly Black Gold Riches
James Henrikson schemes to strike it rich in the North Dakota oil fields, and he lets no one get in his way; when they do, they die.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Hamptons
In Kent County Jail, a well-known inmate is back with more than 130 prior stays; an inside look at life in the one wing of the jail that inmates consider prime real estate, but where one will be expelled for good.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Jail Born
A night at the beach in his brother's truck sends a repeat offender back to jail; a Christmas morning hold-up leaves a young man dead and four people in jail with serious charges.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — He Takes No Prisoners
Grant Culliver, warden of one of Alabama's toughest prisons, Holman Correctional Facility, doesn't miss a beat in getting into a disruptive inmate's face, but he's also compassionate and gentle when the situation calls for it.

title: Lockup: Holman: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Snake and Fluffy
Of the nearly 1,000 inmates at Holman, the 200 most dangerous must be segregated from the rest; Bobby Gilbert, or "Snake.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Defending Bacon
At Wichita's Sedgwick County Jail an inmate launches an attack on another, sending him to the emergency room; a detective must get to the bottom of it, while a pastor hopes to get to the heart of it.

title: Lockup: Wichita: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Lifestyle
Wichita, Kansas and surrounding Sedgwick County take pride in their Wild West roots, but Billy the Kid's gang would be seriously outgunned by the notorious gangs of modern day Wichita.

title: American Greed: Deadly Rich
description:
S1 E4 — The Boy Toy Killer
When a wealthy Texas retiree is found dead in a ravine in Mexico, all eyes turn to his young boyfriend, a porn actor; while investigators uncover the truth behind their relationship, border crossing records provide the key to solving the case.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E5 — Psychic Fiend's Network
A phony psychic scams a wealthy but lonely timber baron out of millions while her devious daughter pretends to be in love with him.
